listings.title: 46k-Mile 2015 BMW X5 xDrive35d M Sport
listings.description: Black Sapphire Metallic over black Dakota leather, 46k miles. Turbodiesel 3.0 inline-six, 8-speed automatic, xDrive. M Sport plus Cold Weather, Luxury Seating, and Premium packages. Panoramic sunroof, xenon, Comfort Access. Rear bumper dent repaired and resprayed. Previously on BaT June 2026. Clean Carfax, Texas title. Private-party no-reserve.

listings.title: 1989 Ferrari 328 GTS
listings.description: Nero over beige leather, 33k miles shown. Fuel-injected 3.2 V8, 5-speed gated, LSD, removable roof. Timing belt 2024. Ferrari Classiche. NAM title issued PA 2015. Dealer no-reserve, clean Missouri title.

listings.title: 1965 Sunbeam Tiger Mk I
listings.description: Midnight Blue originally; refinished current shade in 2007 Canadian refurb. Blue soft top, chrome bumpers, Tiger badges. Scratch on windshield. Offered again by Houston dealer after Aug 2026 BaT. Replacement STOA head noted. Dealer no-reserve, Houston 77074.

listings.title: 28k-Mile 2012 Ford Expedition Limited 4×4
listings.description: 28k-Mile Ingot Silver Metallic Expedition Limited 4×4. Keyless pad, running boards, powered liftgate, receiver hitch. Registered in Washington through July 2026. Humble, TX 77396 no-reserve.

listings.title: 20-Years-Owned, Modified 2000 Chevrolet Camaro SS Coupe
listings.description: Dark gray (repaint) over ebony leather, 35k miles. MTI Houston LS1: C2 cam, Stage 2 heads, LS6 intake. 4-speed auto, Yank stall, Torsen 3.23. T-top rust cut for future bodywork; outdoor parked then recommissioned. Clean Carfax, Texas title odo Exempt. Private-party no-reserve.

listings.title: 26k-Mile 1996 Jaguar XJR
listings.description: Carnival Red over Cream Connolly leather, 26k miles. Supercharged 4.0 inline-six, 4-speed automatic. One of about 2,150 for the model year. Clean Carfax, Virginia title, dealer no-reserve.

listings.title: 59k-Kilometer Japanese-Market 1998 Mercedes-Benz E430 Avantgarde Wagon
listings.description: 59k-Kilometer Japanese-market W210 E430 Avantgarde wagon in Brilliant Silver Metallic, imported to the US. Sunroof, roof rails, AMG badge. Spring, TX 77380 dealer no-reserve.

listings.title: 44k-Mile 2005 Jaguar XK8 Convertible
listings.description: 44k-Mile Ebony Black XK8 convertible with matching soft top; soft-top hydraulic hoses replaced Aug 2026. 4.2 V8. Spring, TX 77380 dealer no-reserve.

listings.title: 1969 Chevrolet Corvette Coupe 427 4-Speed
listings.description: Blue over Bright Blue vinyl, 48k miles shown. Rebuilt 427, 4-speed, Posi, T-tops, Rally wheels, side-exit exhaust. Headlights intermittent, parking brake dead, speedo needle broken. Clean Colorado title. Previously on BaT Aug 2026.
